reproduction: Start backend (npm run validate:local-runtime): process exits 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading id)' at routes/adminRoutes.js:2334

result: FIXED AND PROVEN. New test fails with the original TypeError when the bug is re-introduced and passes with the fix; validate:local-runtime now PASS (live 200, health 200, ready 503 degraded as designed without Supabase).
evidence: None known. Whether the deployed API at api.kayad.space runs this same code is UNVERIFIED (no production access).

reproduction: Owner sends DELETE with no JSON body -> HTTP 500 "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'reason')"

fix: backend/routes/adminRoutes.js: req.body?.reason (same safe expression applied to 3 neighbouring audit lines). Existing body-less DELETE tests now pass.
result: FIXED AND PROVEN. 132/132 pass; two previously failing tests (delete + audit trail) were this defect.
evidence: Other DELETE handlers scanned for the same pattern: none found.
